note: London-open read, Wed 2026-11-25 (~12:40 AM CT; Asia-session levels as of ~06:40 UTC). Quiet Asia after Turnaround Tuesday: DXY 103.97 (+0.12%) steadies after Tuesday's 0.44% slide; EUR/USD 1.0946 and GBP/USD 1.3091 give back a touch of Tuesday's ~0.7% reclaim. The Aussie is the mover: AU CPI beat 4.9% y/y (fcst 4.7%, Sep 4.3%) then AUD/USD gave back the whole pop to 0.6608 (-0.59%) as risk-off swept Asia ahead of the expected US Section 301 tariff-findings report. USD/JPY 159.30 pinned below 160; Japan SPPI beat +4.2% y/y bolsters the BoJ's Dec hike case. Gold slides to ~$3,521 (-1.0%) as the dollar firms; Brent slips under $90 to $89.85, WTI $80.86 — the supply-glut frame still dominates after API's small +0.126M bbl build. Yields steady (10Y 4.90%, 2Y 4.67%); Dec Fed hike ~96% (CME FedWatch). Today is the week's big data day: the 7:30 AM CT cluster (core PCE fcst +0.3% m/m, Q3 GDP 2nd estimate fcst 3.5%, claims fcst 201K) plus the Beige Book at 1:00 PM CT; US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving. Spot levels are indicative index quotes, not executable prices.
